oracle_independence.rule: Expected results are hand-derived from frozen synthetic rows and existing owner laws before any C1 candidate output.
oracle_independence.method: Each oracle below is a frozen table written into c1_at08_at13_fixture.py as a module constant before the corresponding court was executed. The courts then assert producer/composition output against those constants. Where a constant was cross-checked against actual producer facts, that was a verification of the frozen table, not its derivation.

frozen_oracles.mathematics: ATT1 in {agree, disagree}; ATT2 in {support, oppose}. agree: support 54, oppose 6 (n=60). disagree: support 8, oppose 32 (n=40). Column totals support 62, oppose 38, n=100.
Four respondents R00,R01,R10,R11 with C = A xor B. All five unary views of P(C=1) equal 1/2; the four joint conditionals take exactly the values 0 and 1.
Two single-universe sources sharing one question namespace. Left pairs 00,00,11,11; right pairs 01,01,10,10. Both have P(A=1)=2/4 and P(B=1)=2/4 but disjoint joint structure.
frozen_oracles.design_note: Deliberately built as two independently composable single-universe sources rather than one multi-universe query, so the equal-marginal distinction needs no source-comparison or composite authority.

frozen_oracles.mathematics: Coordinate G in {A,B,C} with sizes 10/8/2 and Y=1 support 3/8/2. A is modal, B minority, C counterpattern; all three are supported and none is the pooled product.
R1,R2 with X=1,Y=1; R3 with X=1,Y=0; R4 with X=0,Y=1. Conditioning on X=1 gives an exact same-respondent co-travel cohort of 3 with Y=1 for 2 and Y=0 for 1.
Three respondents each holding one scalar ATT conditioner event and two RANKED_RESPONSE events carrying source-native rank fields. Arity is 1 but the cell value is the ordered vector itself.

Six respondents R1..R6: R1(X=1,H=1,Y=1), R2(X=1,H=1,Y=0), R3(X=1,H=0,Y=1), R4(X=1,H=0,Y=0), R5(X=0,H=1,Y=1), R6(X=0,H=0,Y=0). Generation one forks X=1 from all six (cohort 4); generation two forks H=1 from the discovered child (cohort 2), strictly nested.
frozen_oracles.constant: inline in the court file and in c1_at08_at13_fresh_process_runner._DEPTH2_ROWS
